remedies.identity: P(y|theta,b)/P(S|theta,b)=exp(-sum b_j*y_j)/c_S(b); constant in all latent-only parameters. Integrating correlated, even non-Gaussian, latent laws preserves the posterior under identical priors.
remedies.implementation_plan: Stable log coefficients via dynamic programming, log-sum-exp/softplus denominator, retained item masks/calibration; independent normalization, boundary score, extreme finite b, missing-mask, and likelihood-ratio fixtures. Compare normalized log target up to constant at fixed states and numerical derivatives where engine uses them. Then independent small same-data multi-chain comparison within combined MC uncertainty; failure blocks acceleration.
remedies.limits: Not the Gaussian standardized-total comparator. Unknown calibration breaks the dropped-constant argument; unequal OPLM slopes not covered by this raw-total result. Denominator still costs O(J) without separately validated further work; graph reduction is not measured acceleration. Keep original responses for predictive checks; missingness likelihood must be preserved.

prespecified_validation.scope: All monitored globals/transforms and fixed representative latent/predictive monitors; independent chain/RNG accounting, trace/rank and temporal-drift review. No individual beta1 pass overrides joint failure.
prespecified_validation.HPD: Preserve source95% HPD; inspect chain/split endpoint sensitivity and suitable endpoint uncertainty. Quantile MCSE is not HPD-endpoint MCSE. Withhold classifications unstable to Monte Carlo error; do not relax criteria after inspecting results.
prespecified_validation.aggregation: Fixed intended denominators100/250; retain attempted/valid/failed/timed-out counts and reasons. No favorable-chain selection, seed replacement, duplicate pooling, or concatenation of a restarted chain as a continuation without true sampler state.
prespecified_validation.uncertainty: Separate posterior MC error from across-dataset simulation error and source rounding/extraction uncertainty. Report recovery estimates with MC intervals; power binomial intervals per cell, null rejection fractions separately, and prespecified grid comparisons with multiplicity handled. No numerical match/equivalence assertion without a predeclared margin.
prespecified_validation.unresolved_detection: Report identified count interval [detected/100,(detected+unclassified)/100] plus sampling uncertainty; never drop failures from denominator or silently classify as nondetection.
